title: Grid GMD operating procedure notice
description: A transmission operator's notice that its geomagnetic disturbance operating procedure has been applied, is approaching its condition, or has been terminated: the space weather information received, the predetermined condition met, the actions taken with times and status, who was told, and the condition for termination. The elements follow NERC EOP-010 (information receipt, actions at predetermined conditions, termination conditions, evidence in logs). Actions are those in the entity's own procedure, not engineering advice.

entity.description: The transmission operator or reliability coordinator.

issueTime.description: Time of the notice in UTC and local.

trigger.description: The space weather information received and the predetermined condition it met.
examples: SWPC K-index warning WARK07 serial 214: Kp of 7 expected. Procedure condition: Kp of 7 forecast.

actions.description: Operator actions initiated, with time and status.

action.description: The action as written in the procedure.
examples: Notified generation operators and neighboring transmission operators

time.description: Time of the action in UTC.

status.description: Status: Completed, In progress or Not started.

terminationCondition.description: The condition for ending the procedure.
examples: Kp below 5 for two consecutive three-hour periods and no active SWPC warning.
Exercise record. All names and entities are fictional.
